notes.title: Release date announcement
notes.notes:
Hey all, programmer psy_wombats here with more news. The good news is that we have an official release date! The slightly less great news is that date is March 1st 2024, a bit later than our planned release in 2023, but I can also share what we've been working on and plan to cover with the extra time.

First up, we're overhauling the HUD. Our playtesters identified it as a source of friction and it was in dire need of polish. Artist JoSeraph is working hard on new customizable portraits for party members that fit more with our in-game art style, as well as illustrating the 5th member guest characters. With another coat of paint on the HUD, the game's UI should be a lot more intuitive and appealing. Here's a sneak peak of a few portrait sketches:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43816418/1e375cb476223984d8904e96a9c4da325e6e1629.png[/img]


And as mentioned in our previous update, the in-battle HUD information is moving to the combat screen proper. HP labels and monster quantity indicators are now located in the game itself, so anyone running in classic mode without the HUD isn't at a disadvantage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43816418/0731ad8391244d95587195683054eca7e03ebf4f.png[/img]


Other minor stuff we're covering... We've added about 25 new maps to the game over the past few weeks to break up the tedium of some story areas, we've tweaked battle flow to require less reading, and of course, we're always working on more animations to give each boss a bit more flavor. For a taste, here's our new FLARE animation (because every RPG needs a FLARE)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43816418/251535b9891e7379e9409c954083c54861541ea1.gif[/img]





[table]
    [tr]
        [td][previewyoutube=jwxdPeAt8bQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/td]
        [td]Oh, and of course, composer SG has been working on more BGM. 

Our soundtrack right now is at 40 original chiptune compositions, and we fully plan to offer the OST for download. [/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]




After a brief hiatus on [url=https://twitter.com/VaronisRPG]Twitter[/url], we're also resuming posting. Expect more action as we enter the home stretch. Thanks for following the project and we're all looking forward to sharing it with you!

notes.title: Progress update!
notes.notes:
Hi all! This is programmer psy_wombats here with a brief update on where we're at.

First of all, apologies for the radio silence the past couple months -- we've been concentrating on responding to feedback from our beta testers instead of new features, and bugfixing and balancing are a bit less glamorous than new features. The good news is that we're finally done with our design pass and starting in the last quality-of-life features, animations, and sprites.

First up, we're working on special battle animations for each boss and for high-level magic attacks. Hopefully these should give bosses a bit of flair, and lend a sense of accomplishment to unlocking the strongest magic. Here's a few we're proud of, first for RIME, second for VORTEX:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43816418/f7a74ec7dd18b338dd8a10c2d42f122e66070e67.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43816418/24862daf6c1778020c7bdbc54c04d47984465c48.gif[/img]

We've also been working on a lot of interface improvements to make some of the older-school mechanics easier to understand. For example, we've added visual indicators for groups of enemies, so that when there are three skeletons on the field, you actually see three skeletons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43816418/9e15bf87d3f42e7c078192981d8d1fad973670b9.png[/img]

Apart from that, we've been working on a plethora of polish, like improved controller support, menu overhauls, more speed options, hints, autosaves, etc etc -- basically every convenience players should expect from a modern RPG. While we've certainly been taking more time than we'd like to on these items, hopefully the extra shine will show in the final build. This game is a labor of love and we're all really looking forward to getting it out there.

Anyway! Thanks for following Secret of Varonis and bearing with us as we push towards a final release!
